AppyDave

Three 15-second cuts

CHIANG MAI · 4 SEASONS · AUG 2026

Three treatments of the same hackathon, cut from one real interview. Every number and every quoted word is from that interview — nothing invented. Silent; the narration tracks are separate.

01

One quote, held

9:16 · THE HUMAN OPEN

Built on one verbatim line the participant said twice — the repetition is the beat. Every word on screen is hers, grammar untouched. A synthetic voice never speaks her words.

02

The funnel narrowing

16:9 · THE FACTORY

Many opportunities in, a few get built. The yellow band is the human decision gate — the one step in the pipeline that is deliberately not automated.

03

The evidence base forming

16:9 · THE PRODUCT

Twenty minutes of real interview in fifteen seconds. Transcript, evidence base and coverage filling as the clock runs — landing on four of six criteria, and naming the two it missed.

RENDERED WITH HYPERFRAMES · 15S EACH · 30FPS
